name: Northwind Heating & Air
hours: Monday to Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 8am-2pm. Emergency line answered 24/7.
policies: We never quote prices by email or phone. A technician gives a written estimate at the home, and the estimate visit is free for replacements.
Repair visits are booked in two-hour windows. The office confirms the window by text.
We do not service commercial rooftop units.
